_readme: Per-page <title>, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD for the core pages. tools/build-site.py writes them into each page's BUILD:SEO region. Titles under 60 characters, descriptions under 160. sameAs: add official profile URLs (LinkedIn etc.) when they exist; never guess them.

organization.name: Fusion Connect Group
organization.description: Fusion Connect Group (FCG) is a travel technology company that gives TMCs, travel agencies, builders and corporate travel programmes API access to hotel and flight supply. Started in China, now global.

index.html.title: Fusion Connect Group (FCG): hotel and flight supply APIs
index.html.description: G-Link and F-Link connect TMCs, builders and corporate travel programmes to 4.35M+ hotels and GDS, NDC and LCC flight content through one API.

about.html.title: About Fusion Connect Group (FCG)
about.html.description: Fusion Connect Group (FCG) builds direct, AI-powered API access to hotel and flight supply for travel businesses. Started in China, now global.

addn.html.title: ADDN distribution network | Fusion Connect Group
addn.html.description: ADDN is FCG's AI-Powered Decentralized Distribution Network: independently deployable travel and payment infrastructure that runs across independent hubs.
addn.html.name: ADDN

agreeease.html.title: AgreeEase hotel RFP and rate sourcing | Fusion Connect Group
agreeease.html.description: AgreeEase is a white-label hotel RFP platform: source supply, negotiate terms, sign contracts and get flagged when live rates drift from what you agreed.
agreeease.html.name: AgreeEase

ai-booking-tool.html.title: AI Booking Tool for business travel | Fusion Connect Group
ai-booking-tool.html.description: Travellers plan and book trips in plain language or by voice against FCG's full hotel and flight content, including inside Microsoft 365.
ai-booking-tool.html.name: FCG AI Booking Tool

atlas.html.title: Atlas TMC operating system | Fusion Connect Group
atlas.html.description: Atlas puts a travel team's communications, operations, finance and duty of care in one platform, running on FCG's ADDN network.
atlas.html.name: Atlas

corporate-booking-tool.html.title: White-label corporate booking tool | Fusion Connect Group
corporate-booking-tool.html.description: Run your own branded corporate booking platform on your own domain, connected to FCG's full hotel and flight content. You deploy and operate it.
corporate-booking-tool.html.name: FCG Corporate Booking Tool

developer.html.title: Travel APIs for hotels and flights | Fusion Connect Group
developer.html.description: Build on G-Link and F-Link: one connection to 4.35M+ hotel records plus GDS, NDC and LCC air. Integrate by API, SDK or Skills, with sandbox access.

flink.html.title: F-Link flight content engine | Fusion Connect Group
flink.html.description: F-Link consolidates GDS, NDC and low-cost carrier content into one pre-validated air feed, reachable through a single FCG connection.
flink.html.name: F-Link

glink.html.title: G-Link hotel content engine | Fusion Connect Group
glink.html.description: G-Link normalises GDS, channel manager, aggregator and direct-contract hotel supply into one chain: 4.35M+ hotels in 220+ countries, one connection.
glink.html.name: G-Link

payment.html.title: China hotel payment settlement | Fusion Connect Group
payment.html.description: Settle Chinese hotel bookings without the FX detour. With Conferma, FCG delivers compliant cross-border hotel settlement for TMCs and agencies.
payment.html.name: China hotel payment settlement
